nodes.label: FastAPI Monolith Control Plane
nodes.rationale: Single modular FastAPI monolith chosen over microservices initially so one deploy unit scales control plane via replicas while media scales via FreeSWITCH pods; keeps 80-120K LOC target vs 489K PHP legacy.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL RLS Hash Partitioning
nodes.rationale: Partition by HASH(domain_id) plus RLS chosen to replace manual WHERE domain_uuid filters and ClickHouse sidecar; gives per-tenant pruning, easy DROP/COPY per tenant, keeps stack to single Postgres.

nodes.label: mod_xml_curl On-Demand XML
nodes.rationale: Prefer HTTP mod_xml_curl over file writes plus ESL reloadxml because on-the-fly rendering is instant, cluster-safe, needs no NFS, and control-plane crash does not drop media calls.

nodes.label: Per-Tenant Plugin Registry
nodes.rationale: Typed manifest.toml registry with domain_plugins toggle chosen to replicate FusionPBX 76-app modularity with license gating and lazy React chunks, hiding disabled plugins from nav and returning 403.

nodes.label: Versioned REST API v1
nodes.rationale: Full resource-oriented REST with versioning, pagination, HATEOAS links, idempotency keys and OpenAPI chosen so web, mobile and third-party integrations control the system uniformly.

nodes.label: WebPhoneContext Persistent Provider
nodes.rationale: Context mounted at Nav level keeps SIP registration alive across popup close and route navigation; lazy sip.js import avoids bundle cost when tenant disabled.

nodes.label: webrtc_settings Tenant Table
nodes.rationale: Tenant-level single-row settings table gates enabled/auth_mode/wss_url centrally so WSS endpoint is admin-managed, not per-user drift, enforced by RLS and JWT domain match.

nodes.label: sip.js SIP over WSS Client
nodes.rationale: sip.js 0.21 picked over jssip for maintained TypeScript UserAgent/Registerer/Session API and smaller dependency surface; browsers cannot do raw SIP UDP so RFC 7118 WSS is required.

nodes.label: FreeSWITCH WSS Transport
nodes.rationale: wss-binding on sofia profile or TLS proxy required because browser WebRTC SIP must ride Secure WebSocket; localhost ws exception allows dev without TLS but prod must be wss.

nodes.label: Ohngea PBX Brand System
nodes.rationale: Swahili ongea speak plus Oh delight identity with Speak Connect Ohngea tagline chosen for new product; hard purge of fusion strings required across code, DB, docs and history.

nodes.label: Bubble Wave Logo
nodes.rationale: Speech-bubble plus teal-amber voice waves with currentColor inversion chosen for dark-mode safety and legibility from 16px favicon to 512px PWA without font change.

nodes.label: Git History Purge via filter-repo
nodes.rationale: Destructive filter-repo rewrite with backup tag approved to guarantee zero fusion strings in files, commit messages and branch names; dry-run in /tmp clone before force push.

nodes.label: WebPhoneDock Persistent Mini-Bar
nodes.rationale: Fixed bottom-right dock keeps call controls visible across routes for call-center agents who redial fast; survives navigation where Dialog popup loses context.

nodes.label: WebPhonePanel Tabbed Panel
nodes.rationale: Single Sheet/Dialog with Dialpad History Contacts Settings tabs reuses one store so Phase 2 queue and Phase 3 transfer plug in without rewiring; popup kept as thin wrapper for test compat.

nodes.label: LocalStorage Call History
nodes.rationale: History kept client-side capped at 100 with optional DB stub fallback so UX ships with no migration; per domain_id:user_uuid keys prevent cross-tenant leaks.

nodes.label: Tiered E2E Harness
nodes.rationale: Three tiers (sqlite pytest, stateful mock ESL, real FS Docker) let agents iterate handsfree in seconds by default and only pay Docker cost when touching dialplan/directory/CDR/ESL code.

nodes.label: Scenario SIP Phones
nodes.rationale: Stdlib sip_endpoint modes (answer, originate, busy 486, no-answer 408, dtmf, refer, conference-join) prove follow-me, ring-group fan-out, IVR and queue bridging via signaling plus CDR without audio assertion.

nodes.label: Real FreeSWITCH Honest Status
nodes.rationale: Local-only honest approach removes freeswitch-mock listener from :8021 so ESL probe and FsStatus dot surface real outages instead of masking them with fake RUNNING.

nodes.label: Mock ESL Fallback
nodes.rationale: In-process mock kept for offline unit tests and CI but must never bind :8021 locally and RealEs.api +OK mock-fallback must not mask status paths; repo-wide removal deferred as too blast-radius heavy.
